items.title: Frozen exe YOLO prepare asyncio fix (ISS-077): --collect-submodules asyncio added to PyInstaller build args in build_smart_sentry_v2_3_2_portable.ps1. In Python 3.11, asyncio/__init__.py eagerly imports asyncio.base_events and all other asyncio.* submodules at package init time. import torch triggers typing_extensions._deprecated which executes asyncio/__init__.py, so all asyncio.* submodules must be bundled or YOLO prepare fails with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'asyncio.base_events'. Failure was visible in SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_FILES/logs/yolo_runtime_diag.log as repeated prepare-failed entries. SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md and SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md updated.

Frozen exe numpy._core._exceptions fix (ISS-076): --collect-submodules numpy added to PyInstaller build args in build_smart_sentry_v2_3_2_portable.ps1. NumPy 2.x restructured C extensions into numpy._core.* submodules that the standard hook does not enumerate; without this flag the frozen app crashed at cv2 import time with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'numpy._core._exceptions'. SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md and SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md updated.

Frozen exe numpy double-import fix and versionless codebase refactor (ISS-075): removed module-level _preload_torch_runtime() and _configure_ml_runtime_env() calls from app/main.py that caused PyInstaller's 'cannot load module more than once per process' crash (torch+numpy loaded at from app.main import main time, then cv2->numpy triggered a second load). Deleted versioned launcher chain (run_smart_sentry_v2_3_2.py, run_smart_sentry_v3_0_0.py); run.py now uses a direct from app.main import main import with no dispatch logic. Build script and packaging preflight updated to reference app.main directly. SMART_SENTRY_ISSUE_LOG.md and SMART_SENTRY_V3_0_0_COMPILATION_PROTOCOL.md updated.

Graceful exit splash overlay: closing the app now shows a centered DB3K logo card over the main window. The camera feed is stopped immediately so the logo renders cleanly. Four animated status steps (Closing camera feed -> Returning turret to rest position -> Disconnecting from boards -> Turning off accessories) play out with trailing-dot animation and a thin 3 px gradient progress bar while the turret physically returns to its rest position. Once the underlying cleanup() finishes the overlay transitions to All systems safe - Goodbye, the bar fills to 100%, and the window closes after a 900 ms pause. The hardware shutdown sequence, rest_on_close_enabled, and rest_close_timeout_ms behavior are unchanged. SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md updated.

Codebase simplification and movement bug fix pass: deleted 3-hop wrapper launcher chain (run_smart_sentry_v3_0_0.py, run_smart_sentry_v3.py, run_smart_sentry_v2_3_1.py), hardcoded canonical launcher in run.py and build script, consolidated 10 config files to 4 canonical v3_0_0 files, removed 12 debug print(flush=True) calls from sentry_v2_engine.py hot path that were causing OS-level write syscall blocking during precision tracking, and replaced all try/except dual-import chains with single app.* imports across sentry_v2_config.py, sentry_v2_tab.py, smart_sentry_meta.py, db3k_meta.py, and face_identity.py.

Auto Lighting Control fully activated and WiFi adapter stability fix: ACCESSORY_PWM_ENABLED set to 1 in both ESP32 firmware sketches, compiled and flashed to COM28 (ESP32-D0WD-V3). LED now auto-adjusts brightness via 8-bit LEDC PWM at 5 kHz based on live scene luminance. Windows WiFi stability improved: ConnectionConfig now carries a wifi_interface field, a new WiFi Adapter dropdown lists all detected adapters, and USB selective suspend was disabled for the SMART SENTRY CON dongle. Ctrl+Alt+L shortcut registered. Docs updated: SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md, SMART_SENTRY_SHORTCUT_KEYS.md, AUTO_LIGHTING_CONTROL_IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE.md.

ESP32 accessory PWM MOSFET infrastructure: both ESP32 sketches now include compile-time ACCESSORY_PWM_ENABLED flag (default 0 = off). When set to 1, all four outputs are driven by 8-bit LEDC PWM via MOSFET driver (5 kHz); a bool-compat helper maps legacy ON/OFF app commands to full duty cycle (255) without any app-side change. Motion, fire, safety, PIR, buzzer, telemetry, and link-loss safe mode are unaffected. ESP32_CURRENT_SKETCH.md updated.

Smart Sentry YOLO autotracking and loss-recovery fix (ISS-070, ISS-071, ISS-073): min_threat_score lowered to 0.25; fire_trigger_enter tolerances corrected to realistic YOLO-tracking values (2.5 deg/2.0 deg) and aim-lock tolerances widened to 3.0 deg/2.5 deg with required frames reduced from 7 to 2; semantic_min_confirm_frames reduced to 1 to fix loss-recovery re-detection failure caused by ByteTrack track_id resets, with loss_local_search spans widened to 20 deg/12 deg, dwell increased to 0.40s, and target_loss_timeout extended to 5.0s. app/config/smart_sentry_v3_0_0_settings.json and validate_settings.py updated.

Smart Sentry packaged OpenCV data fix: app/sentry_v2/face_identity.py now resolves the Haar cascade from valid packaged/runtime locations and falls back cleanly when the asset is absent. SmartSentryV2.spec and build_smart_sentry_v2_3_2_portable.ps1 now explicitly bundle cv2/data into the portable release.

Smart Sentry packaged YOLO runtime-prep fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now prepares frozen DLL search paths without the recursion-prone path-resolution step that could fail before torch imported, keeps add_dll_directory handles alive for the process lifetime, and reports the exception type in YOLO runtime-prep failures. tools/repro_yolo_prepare.py was added to reproduce the frozen-runtime helper path outside the EXE.

Smart Sentry 1280x720 Windows camera fix: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py now rejects black or partial startup frames during integer-camera probing and now prefers MSMF, then DEFAULT, then DSHOW on Windows. MSMF held a stable full-resolution feed so the runtime now chooses it over DSHOW which produced persistent partial frames on this machine.

Smart Sentry keyboard-control safety update: app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_config.py now persists a separate manual movement/fire keyboard-enable flag that defaults off, and app/sentry_v2/sentry_v2_tab.py adds a Shortcut Keys checkbox for those risky controls, wires W/A/S/D and hold-to-fire Space through the same manual movement and fire paths as the on-screen controls. SMART_SENTRY_SHORTCUT_KEYS.md and SMART_SENTRY_MANUAL.md synced.
